# claude-subagent

> Native-grade Skill + CLI architecture turning Claude Code (native or paired with `crouter`) into a fast, streaming, target-workspace-bound, worktree-isolated subagent pool with `send`, `fork`, `ps`, `stop`, `models`, `doctor`, and zero external dependencies.

- [README](README.md): Overview, installation (`npx skills add Luckycat133/claude-subagent`, `uv tool install`, `./install.sh`), first-run setup, and quickstart.
- [README (简体中文)](README.zh-CN.md): Chinese documentation.
- [Agent Skill](skills/claude-subagent/SKILL.md): Universal `claude-subagent` skill covering setup preflight, proactive team spin-up, outcome-oriented briefing, and verification.
- [Team Topologies](skills/claude-subagent/references/team-topologies.md): Minimal effective team topologies and concise brief contract.
- [Exception Handling](skills/claude-subagent/references/exception-handling.md): Structured recovery playbook for review loops, user/GUI contention, timeouts, and outages.
- [Recipes & Flags](skills/claude-subagent/references/recipes-and-flags.md): Setup commands, everyday recipes, full CLI flag & environment variable reference.
- [CLI Source](src/claude_subagent/cli.py): Stdlib-only Python 3.9+ runner.
- [Starter Agents](agents/workflow-implementer.md): Optional `workflow-researcher`, `workflow-implementer`, and `workflow-reviewer` definitions for `~/.claude/agents/`.
